lines: css holds 1 stylesheet, 102 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
core-js, 39,335 B on the nextcloud-swarm-plugin-main page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
lodash, 19,568 B on the nextcloud-swarm-plugin-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
4 delivered files carry no source map, so those bytes are counted but charged to no package.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (69 packages, 429 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
